rooms.name: In the Corner of a Battlefield
rooms.desc:
You are in the corner of a large battlefield. Piles of corpses have been left
here so as not to make a disadvantage for the warriors who fight in the
battlefield. To the north and west are mountains, to the south and east lies
the battlefield.
